result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: a stuck loading spinner overlaying an already rendered restaurant card image.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is stuck overlapping the center of the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' image under the 'Popular right now' section, even though the image and page content have already loaded.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the loading indicator or pull-to-refresh spinner is properly hidden and unmounted once the image or data fetch completes.
